messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a pre-merge terraform apply for a partial vpc-routing cutover tonight during the 23:00 UTC change window. Affects route tables and a peering attachment for tenant-b. tagging @maria @jo @ops-oncall and @deploybot for preflight checks.

maria: ACK. I can be on-call for the window. What’s the canary plan?

alex: Canary = route a 10% traffic shadow to the new peering for 10 minutes, validate connectivity and latency, then proceed with staged route updates. If any step fails we stop and revert the route table entries.

jo: Noted one potential drift: the db-subnet tag differs in staging vs prod, I’ll push a quick module patch to align tags (small tf change). Will open a PR now.

alex: Thanks. Preflight commands I ran:
```
terraform init -backend-config=prod.tfbackend
terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars -out=/tmp/plan.vpc-cutover
```
Preflight checks passed except the tag drift jo mentioned.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks completed for branch alex/vpc-cutover. Merge queue position: 2. No blocking CI failures.

ops-oncall: I’ll monitor flow logs, route propagation, and the latency dashboard. Thresholds: packet loss >1% or tail latency +50ms triggers abort.

alex: Rollback procedure (manual quick run):
1) Abort apply if flagged.
2) Run `terraform apply -refresh-only` to snap resources, then `scripts/rollback-vpc-cutover.sh` which re-applies previous route entries from snapshot.
3) If tfstate is needed: `terraform state pull > snapshot-1719204321.tfstate` then restore the snapshot.

maria: Sounds good. I updated the release notes PR with the change summary and rollback steps: https://git.internal/rn/1234 — please review.

alex: Plan is to schedule apply at 23:05 UTC (after mergebot fast-forward), quiet window until 23:45 UTC. If mergebot stalls, we abort and reschedule to the next slot.

deploybot: Merge queued — apply scheduled at 23:05 UTC. Will post apply start/complete messages to this thread and #release-war-room.

jo: I merged the tag-fix PR. Verified that `terraform plan` no longer shows tag drift locally.

ops-oncall: If we see BGP flaps or unexpected route withdrawals during the canary, I’ll open an incident and request an immediate abort. I have the rollback script ready and a runbook pinned.

alex: After apply we’ll run the smoke test: `tools/smoke/routetest.sh --targets tenant-b --runs 50` — looks for successful TCP connections and <10ms median latency. Please do not promote the change to the wider fleet until smoke passes.

maria: I’ll wait for the smoke pass + 15min steady before signing off.

alex: Thanks everyone. Posting final status here after the window. If you see anything odd ping me directly. :thumbsup:

deploybot: apply started at 23:05:12 UTC (apply id abcd-1719204321).

deploybot: apply finished at 23:12:08 UTC — no errors.

ops-oncall: Observability: canary shadow saw normal connection rates, latency +3ms median, no packet loss. No incidents.

alex: Smoke tests passed (50/50). Promoting out of canary per plan. Will follow up with release notes final update.

maria: Great job, closing out from my side.

alex: Closing — final status posted to #release-war-room and release notes updated. Thank you all.
